   67: init_per_suite(Config) ->
   68:     ok = inets:start(),
   69:     Config.
   70: 
   71: end_per_suite(Config) ->
   72:     ok = inets:stop(),
   73:     Config.
   74: 
   75: init_per_group(Group, Config) ->
   76:     Groupname = atom_to_list(Group),
   77:     Groupdir = proplists:get_value(data_dir, Config) ++ Groupname,
   78:     Fromdir = Groupdir ++ "/fixture",
   79:     Todir = proplists:get_value(priv_dir, Config) ++ "/inte/" ++ Groupname ++ "/fixture",
   80:     copy_fixture(Fromdir, Todir),
   81:     {ok, _Pid} = hty_main:start([Todir]),
   82:     [{wwwroot, Todir},
   83:      {files_dir, Groupdir ++ "/files"}|Config].
   84: 
   85: end_per_group(Group, Config) ->
   86:     ok = hty_main:stop(),
   87:     Config.
   88: 
   89: init_per_testcase(Test, Config) ->
   90:     io:format(user, "About to start httpc with profile ~p~n", [Test]),
   91:     {ok, _} = inets:start(httpc, [{profile, Test}]),
   92:     [{tc_name, Test}|Config].
   93: 
   94: end_per_testcase(Test, _Config) ->
   95:     %Httpcpid = proplists:get_value(httpc_pid, Config, no_httpc_pid_config),
   96:     ok = inets:stop(httpc, Test).
   97: 
   98: %%% Support
   99: copy_fixture(From, To) ->
  100:     case filelib:is_dir(From) of
  101:         true ->
  102:             filelib:ensure_dir(To),
  103:             file:make_dir(To),
  104:             {ok, Filenames} = file:list_dir(From),
  105:             lists:foreach(fun(Filename) ->
  106:                 copy_fixture(From ++ "/" ++ Filename, To ++ "/" ++ Filename)
  107:             end, Filenames);
  108:         false ->
  109:             ok = filelib:ensure_dir(To),
  110:             io:format("Copying from ~s to ~s", [From, To]),
  111:             {ok, _} = file:copy(From, To)
  112:     end.

  114: -record(exchange, {
  115:     method = get,
  116:     req_headers = [],
  117:     req_file = none,
  118:     req_body = none,
  119:     url = no_url,
  120:     status = 200,
  121:     rsp_headers = [],
  122:     rsp_body = no_rsp_body,
  123:     rsp_file = no_rsp_file,
  124:     rsp_pattern = no_rsp_pattern,
  125:     entity_compare = strict :: strict | trimmed
  126: }).
  127: 
  128: run_test(Exchanges, Config) ->
  129:     Testcase = proplists:get_value(tc_name, Config),
  130:     run_test(Testcase, Exchanges, Config).
  131: 
  132: run_test(Test, Exchange, Config) when is_record(Exchange, exchange) ->
  133:   run_test(Test, [Exchange], Config);
  134: run_test(Test, Exchanges, Config) when is_list(Exchanges) ->
  135:     Filesdir = proplists:get_value(files_dir, Config)
  136:       ++ "/" ++ atom_to_list(Test) ++ "/",
  137:     lists:foreach(fun(X) ->
  138:         Request = case {X#exchange.req_file, X#exchange.req_body} of
  139:           {none, none} -> {
  140:               X#exchange.url,
  141:               X#exchange.req_headers
  142:           };
  143:           {Reqfile, none} -> {
  144:               X#exchange.url,
  145:               X#exchange.req_headers,
  146:               proplists:get_value("content-type",
  147:                 X#exchange.req_headers, "application/octet-stream"),
  148:               hty_result:assume_ok(file:read_file(Filesdir ++ Reqfile))
  149:           };
  150:           {none, Reqbody} -> {
  151:             X#exchange.url,
  152:             X#exchange.req_headers,
  153:             proplists:get_value("content-type",
  154:               X#exchange.req_headers, "application/octet-stream"),
  155:             Reqbody
  156:           };
  157:           {_,_} -> error(dont_specify_both_req_file_and_req_body)
  158:         end,
  159:         {ok, Response} = httpc:request(
  160:             X#exchange.method,
  161:             Request,
  162:             [], % HttpOptions
  163:             [{body_format, binary}], % Options
  164:             Test),
  165:         {{_, Status, StatusMessage}, ResponseHeaders, Body} = Response,
  166:         case X#exchange.status of
  167:             undefined -> ok;
  168:             Status -> ok;
  169:             _ -> notok = io:format("Wrong status [~p ~p]~n", [Status, StatusMessage])
  170:         end,
  171:         lists:foreach(fun({Name, Value}) ->
  172:             io:format("Looking for header ~s=~s in ~p~n", [Name, Value, ResponseHeaders]),
  173:             true = lists:member({Name, Value}, ResponseHeaders)
  174:         end, X#exchange.rsp_headers),
  175: 
  176:         case X#exchange.rsp_pattern of
  177:           no_rsp_pattern -> ok;
  178:           Pattern ->
  179:             case re:compile(Pattern) of
  180:               {ok, Mp} ->
  181:                 case re:run(Body, Mp) of
  182:                   {match, _} -> ok;
  183:                   nomatch ->
  184:                    throw({error, ["Expected match against ", Pattern, " but got ", Body]})
  185:                 end;
  186:               {error, {Error, Pos}} ->
  187:                 throw({error, ["Bad regex", Error, Pos]})
  188:             end
  189:         end,
  190: 
  191:         case X#exchange.rsp_body of
  192:             no_rsp_body -> ok;
  193:             Body -> ok;
  194:             OtherBody ->
  195:               case X#exchange.entity_compare of
  196:                 strict -> 
  197:                   throw({error, ["Expected ", Body, " but got ", OtherBody]});  
  198:                 trimmed -> trim_compare(OtherBody, Body)
  199:               end
  200:         end,
  201:         case X#exchange.rsp_file of
  202:             no_rsp_file -> ok;
  203:             Filename ->
  204:                 Filepath = Filesdir ++ Filename,
  205:                 io:format("Reading facit file ~s~n", [Filepath]),
  206:                 {ok, Facit} = file:read_file(Filepath),
  207:                 io:format("About to compare facit [~s]~n with response body [~s]~n", [Facit, Body]),
  208:                 case X#exchange.entity_compare of
  209:                   strict -> Facit = Body;
  210:                   trimmed -> trim_compare(Facit, Body)
  211:                 end
  212:         end
  213:     end, Exchanges).
  214: 
  215: trim_compare(Bin1, Bin2) when is_binary(Bin1) ->
  216:   trim_compare(binary_to_list(Bin1), Bin2);
  217: trim_compare(Str1, Bin2) when is_binary(Bin2) ->
  218:   trim_compare(Str1, binary_to_list(Bin2));
  219: trim_compare(Str1, Str2) ->
  220:   S1 = string:trim(Str1),
  221:   S2 = string:trim(Str2),
  222:   S1 = S2.
  223:
